newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria cuts Mostostal Z to "hold".
newsitem.headline: IB Austria cuts Mostostal Z to "hold".

text.p: Investmentbank Austria Research in Vienna has downgraded Polish builder Mostostal Zabrze SA to "hold" from "accumulate" after poor first-half group earnings and two-million-zlotys in flood damage a subsidiary incurred.

"This, combined with poor H1 results for the group, causes us to revise our net profit forecast (which we considered to be conservative) by some 20 percent from 17.6 million zlotys to 15 million zlotys and we thus downgrade the stock from Accumulate to Hold," IB Austria said in a report dated August 13.
